I told Dana, in a reply to her thread, that the deadline is 20 November.

That date comes from Ilse's message in #north-team on 14 October. Nothing posted in the channel since has changed it. I didn't find a separate discussion where the date was agreed, so I suggested Dana check with Ilse if the tracker needs it confirmed as final.

The deadline is a date, not a money figure, and everyone in the channel could already see it, so I could share it there.
